title: Everyone Paired Off
old_caption: When your friends pair up, it's easy to quietly drift home. Your friends still want you around. Say what you miss out loud and ask for the plan you want.

title: No Dance Partner
old_caption: A slow song, no partner, and a mug to hold. The dance floor takes singles. Dance with your friends, or just the beat, like the song is yours.

title: The Set-Up
old_caption: A friend has someone "perfect" for you, and you're not ready. Thank them, be clear and stay kind. "Not yet" is a kind answer.

title: Know Your Yes
old_caption: Not sure what you want in a partner? Single time is a great time to find out. Write down your yeses and your dealbreakers before you need them.

title: The Invite
old_caption: Invited to someone's family dinner and worried you'd be in the way? They asked because they want you there. Letting people in is allowed.

title: The Midnight Hug
old_caption: Worried about having no one to hug at midnight? Midnight hugs come in friend sizes. Make a plan with the people you love and hug whoever shows up.

title: The Year You Built
old_caption: Think nothing happened this year because you stayed single? Look again. New skills, new friends, small brave moments. You built a lot.

title: Curious Again
old_caption: Happy on your own and starting to feel curious? That's a good sign. Ready feels like curious, not lonely. Go slow and let the conversation come first.

title: The Thriving Party
old_caption: Single isn't a waiting room. It's a life, and it's worth celebrating out loud. Tag the friends who'd be first through the door at your thriving party.

title: Hosting Solo, Full House
old_caption:
Hosting dinner on your own, and someone asks who helps you do all this.
A home for one can still be full. Let your guests help; that's what they're there for.
